package nats_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	messageadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/message/nats"
)

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequested(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{
		"schema_version":1,
		"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"occurred_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"event_sequence":4,
		"source_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"source_message_sequence":2,
		"channel":"telegram",
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"practice_task",
		"context_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		"learning_action_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	}`)
	request, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, request.ContextType)
	require.Equal(t, "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", request.LearningActionID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram, request.SourceChannel)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedMapsGeneralContext(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{
		"schema_version":1,
		"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"occurred_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"event_sequence":1,
		"source_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"source_message_sequence":1,
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher",
		"context_id":null,
		"learning_action_id":null
	}`)
	request, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextGeneral, request.ContextType)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, request.SourceChannel)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedAcceptsDenseV2Correlation(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{
		"schema_version":2,
		"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"occurred_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"event_sequence":4,
		"teacher_turn_sequence":2,
		"source_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"source_message_sequence":9,
		"canonical_student_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"correlation_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"causation_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"channel":"web",
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher",
		"context_id":null,
		"learning_action_id":null
	}`)
	request, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2, request.SchemaVersion)
	require.Equal(t, int64(2), request.TeacherTurnSequence)
	require.True(t, request.UsesDenseTeacherOrdering())
	require.Equal(t, request.CanonicalStudentMessageID, request.DialogCausationID)
	require.Equal(t, request.EventID, request.CausationID)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedRejectsIncompleteDenseV2(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{
		"schema_version":2,
		"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"occurred_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"event_sequence":4,
		"teacher_turn_sequence":2,
		"source_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"source_message_sequence":9,
		"channel":"web",
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher",
		"context_id":null,
		"learning_action_id":null
	}`)
	_, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedV2MapsActionReceiptLedger(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{
		"schema_version":2,
		"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"occurred_at":"2026-09-09T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"event_sequence":4,
		"teacher_turn_sequence":1,
		"source_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"source_message_sequence":2,
		"canonical_student_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"correlation_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		"causation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"action_receipt_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		"channel":"web",
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher",
		"context_id":null,
		"learning_action_id":null
	}`)
	request, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", request.ActionReceiptID)
	require.Equal(t, request.ActionReceiptID, request.CorrelationID)
	require.Equal(t, "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", request.DialogCausationID)
	require.Equal(t, request.CanonicalStudentMessageID, request.DialogCausationID)
	require.Equal(t, request.EventID, request.CausationID, "Teacher-job causation is derived from source event")

	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, request.OccurredAt)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, request.ActionReceiptID, job.Request.ActionReceiptID)
	require.Equal(t, request.CanonicalStudentMessageID, job.Request.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	require.Empty(t, request.StudentCommandID, "Dialog v2 never supplies a Teacher-owned Student command ID")
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedV2RejectsTeacherOwnedStudentCommandID(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{
		"schema_version":2,
		"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"occurred_at":"2026-09-09T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"event_sequence":4,
		"teacher_turn_sequence":1,
		"source_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"source_message_sequence":2,
		"canonical_student_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"correlation_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		"causation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"action_receipt_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		"student_command_id":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
		"channel":"web",
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher",
		"context_id":null,
		"learning_action_id":null
	}`)

	_, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "student_command_id")
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedV2RejectsActionReceiptCorrelationOrCausationDrift(t *testing.T) {
	base := `{
		"schema_version":2,"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","occurred_at":"2026-09-09T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","event_sequence":4,"teacher_turn_sequence":1,
		"source_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888","source_message_sequence":2,
		"canonical_student_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"correlation_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999","causation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"action_receipt_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		"channel":"web","student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher","context_id":null,"learning_action_id":null
	}`
	for name, replacement := range map[string]string{
		"correlation drift":     `"correlation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"`,
		"event causation drift": `"causation_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"`,
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			payload := []byte(strings.Replace(base, map[string]string{
				"correlation drift":     `"correlation_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"`,
				"event causation drift": `"causation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"`,
			}[name], replacement, 1))
			_, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext, "invalid V2 action event must be Term-worthy")
		})
	}
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedRejectsUnknownFields(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{"schema_version":1,"unexpected":true}`)
	_, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(payload)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherRequestedV2SourceVersionDistinguishesOmittedFromNull(t *testing.T) {
	base := `{
		"schema_version":2,"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","occurred_at":"2026-09-10T10:00:00Z",
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","event_sequence":4,"teacher_turn_sequence":1,
		"source_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888","source_message_sequence":2,
		"canonical_student_message_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888","correlation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888","causation_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		"channel":"web","student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"general_teacher","context_id":null,"learning_action_id":null%s
	}`
	for name, suffix := range map[string]string{
		"old v2 omits":           "",
		"new v2 positive":        `,"source_message_version":3,"reply_to_message_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"`,
		"explicit null rejected": `,"source_message_version":null,"reply_to_message_id":null`,
		"explicit zero rejected": `,"source_message_version":0,"reply_to_message_id":null`,
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request, err := messageadapter.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(base, suffix)))
			if strings.Contains(name, "rejected") {
				require.Error(t, err)
				return
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if strings.Contains(name, "positive") {
				require.Equal(t, int64(3), request.SourceMessageVersion)
				require.True(t, request.HasFrozenOnboardingReplyMetadata())
			} else {
				require.False(t, request.HasFrozenOnboardingReplyMetadata())
			}
		})
	}
}
